releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v6.6.0 Universal Hardware Diagnostics & Solutions Release:
- Universal Hardware Compatibility Matrix: Detects OEM platform (HP, Lenovo, ASUS, Dell, Acer, MSI, Alienware, Generic ACPI) and analyzes 12 core subsystems.
- 4-Tier Live Status & Solutions Engine: Explains the live condition of every feature (Active, Standby, Restricted, Hardware Locked) and provides 1-Click Fixes.
- Interactive Clickable Badges: Clicking any card's top-right status pill opens the Diagnostics Matrix pre-focused on that feature.
- Master Auto-Optimize Button: Resolves all fixable restrictions (GPU clock tweaks, power plans, 144Hz, battery conservation) in one click.
- Clean UI Typography & Overlap Fixes: Zero text collision and sharp UTF-8 Unicode glyphs.
